text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Messiah-san! I'm so sorry to keep 
you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, right on time. ...Now then, let's head 
to the clubroom first, shall we? We can 
change into tracksuits there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
A clubroom...! You mean for your team, 
Trainer <username>... That's right, isn't it...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right now, I'm the only one you're 
training, so we're still a provisional 
team. Our clubroom might be small, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we have plenty of lockers to 
spare. ...Besides, it's a place you will 
eventually be using yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How about we treat it as a preliminary 
scouting visit?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely!! I would love to 
visit...!!

The seasons steadily turned. Our fourth 
spring together with Air Messiah had 
arrived—

"Although it was still only on a 
'provisional' basis, a new Umamusume had 
joined our team."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! Thanks for your hard work!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
today.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
Until recently, it was just the two of 
them. But now, as three, they exchange a 
proper bow.

Now, first let's review the menu. My 
instructions to Air Messiah will remain 
the same as the other day—
choice_data_list:
You have a mock race coming up soon, 
right?

You have a mock race coming up soon, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! So please, give me a routine 
tailored for real races!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
So... if I can show proper results there, 
I was hoping you'd take me on as an 
official trainee...!
choice_data_list:
Okay... Let's start with a warm-up for 
now—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah-- WOOOOOOOOAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...You certainly seem all fired up.
choice_data_list:
Maybe they're fired up about making the 
main team. But still—

text_block_list.text:
"I didn't actually set any conditions to 
begin with, though," she muttered quietly 
under her breath. ...Indeed, it was the 
girl herself who had requested a 
provisional membership first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Rather than cautious, it is an 
exceedingly humble proposal, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She likely desires the certainty that she 
is worthy of recognition.
choice_data_list:
Conviction... So that's what the "results" 
are for.

text_block_list.text:
Well, on top of that, it's a team where 
she can study under the one and only 
Umamusume she looks up to. I understand 
why she's so fired up, but—
choice_data_list: Just like you, she's so earnest.
Just like you, she's so earnest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Am I really that stubborn?
choice_data_list: That... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Neither she nor I would appreciate 
hearing that from you, of all people.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Haa, phew... Trainer! That's 3 laps on the 
dirt done!
choice_data_list: Ah, right! Then next up—
Ah, yeah! Then next up is—

text_block_list.text:
...And so arrived the day of the mock 
race.

She diligently followed my instructions 
even though I was only her provisional 
Trainer, working tirelessly alongside Air 
Messiah as they headed into the actual 
race, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah... Damn it—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she blew right past in a flash! What 
an incredible closing kick... As expected 
of the Satono family's lady!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly! Crossing the finish line in 
1st place just like that... That girl's 
natural talent is on a completely 
different level!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. For ending up with such a 
pathetic result."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Guided by you two, I gave it my absolute 
all in training, and I did my very best on 
race day, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, Dia-san was just 
overwhelmingly stronger. I think it really 
was as simple as that."
choice_data_list: ...Don't brood over it too much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is just as your Trainer says. You are 
still in the middle of your development, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Your 'journey' is only just beginning. 
—Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, you're right...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep walking forward. Carrying in my 
heart everything Messiah-san engraved upon 
me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
People often tell me that too... Things 
like 'almost' or 'just one step short.'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe the same thing will happen in races 
too. I mean, that's exactly what happened 
this time."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Still... I will not stop moving forward!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Until I can take that "one last step," 
again and again! I'll keep challenging it. 
I'll keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Building it up, step by step! Toward 
glory, toward victory, I'll reach it 
through sheer tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"At this point, I don't care how it looks. 
Turf or dirt, any distance, anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I run. I step forward. Because that is the 
most precious lesson you ever gave me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the strongest figure shown 
to me by the one I admire...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please, walk forward. With your own legs. 
Toward your future.

And then one day, I received an unusual 
message from Air Messiah that wasn't a 
daily report.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work. Have you 
decided on your plans for the weekend?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "If you're still available—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Would you like to go for a walk?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hello, Trainer. Thank you for 
coming.
choice_data_list: No, no, thank you for inviting me...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Well then, shall we head out?

Air Messiah began walking after saying 
that... and together, we truly enjoyed our 
"stroll."
Relaxed and easy. Keeping pace together.

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! Bow-wow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how cute... Is that a beagle? Hello 
there. You're looking quite lively.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so sorry, he's quite a handful! 
Come on now, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Bow-wow!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, and off they go. Their walk looks 
like fun too.
choice_data_list: That beagle's so full of energy and cute.

That beagle's so full of energy and cute, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you like dogs too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In that case... shall we head toward the 
park? I'm sure there are plenty of dogs 
out for a walk.
choice_data_list: Is it okay to change the destination?
Can we change where we're headed?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, feel free. The original destination 
was merely set for convenience anyway—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Besides, I wanted to see it too. The dog.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu, that was so cute. I never 
expected to be surrounded by five 
Chihuahuas.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you alright? It looked like 
quite a lot of them were climbing up your 
legs.
choice_data_list:
I-I'm fine. You're staying nice and 
calm...

I-I'm fine. You're staying nice and 
calm...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... My apologies, I couldn't help 
but look on with a fond smile.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. Don't you smell something nice?
choice_data_list:
Hm? ...You're right. Is that the scent of 
flowers?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Could there be a flower bed over there? 
...Let's head over and take a look then.

...Even after that, I continued walking 
with Air Messiah. Past the blooming, 
colorful flower beds, and all the way down 
the path that stretched beyond them.

Past the playground equipment echoing with 
children's laughter. Around the pond where 
waterfowls frolic.
Air Messiah and I kept walking. And then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, please come a little 
closer this way.
choice_data_list: Oops! Sorry, thanks for letting me know.

text_block_list.text:
While taking a short break on the mountain 
pass, I realized I was accidentally 
standing right on the Umamusume-only lane.

Pointed out by Air Messiah, I hurriedly 
back away from the spot. Then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two! Figh-ting-oh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, where's Trainer? Aren't they 
following along?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Said their moped stalled out~ They called 
for repairs, so we're supposed to wait at 
the summit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... Hey, Leader, if we slow down 
just a tiny bit, nobody's gonna notice, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
No way. Come on, don't just chat, call it 
out! One-two, one-two-!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...They were wearing Tracen Academy 
jerseys. Looks like they're out on a team 
run.
choice_data_list: Thank goodness you didn't get run over...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Though surely, before that happens, 
the other party would notice and dodge.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We take those kinds of lessons from a 
young age, too—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Those girls from before, they're 
completely out of sight now, aren't they?"
choice_data_list: It's true.

text_block_list.text:
"Squinting, I looked up ahead along the 
mountain pass. At a speed impossible to 
catch up to without a vehicle, the 
Umamusume raced ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...The top speed of an Umamusume in her 
prime after reaching maturity is 
approximately 70 km/h."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, they were running at a fairly 
brisk pace... reaching around 40 km/h, I'd 
say.
choice_data_list: You really are... fast, huh.
You really are... fast, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. After all, it's often said that we 
were born to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still, that's precisely why――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad to be an Umamusume who 'walks 
forward'. That's what I truly feel."

Her quiet glance brings me to my senses. 
...I've been walking alongside her all day 
today. A pleasant breeze caresses my 
lightly sweating body.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It may be impossible for us to run at the 
same speed. However, if we are merely 
walking...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Together, looking at the same scenery. At 
the same pace, moving forward side by 
side.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's why this was for the best.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, step by step. Precisely because it 
was a journey that could only be built 
with steady persistence.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To be standing side by side with you like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Could anyone ever be as blessed as 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "That's why I'm glad I was me. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad it was you. I truly mean that 
from the bottom of my heart.
